query:
SELECT DISTINCT
                            substr(lb.file_path, 1, instr(lb.file_path, '/') - 1) AS "child!: String"
                        FROM library_books lb
                        INNER JOIN books b ON b.fingerprint = lb.book_fingerprint
                        WHERE lb.library_id = ?1
                          AND b.status = 'active'
                          AND lb.file_path LIKE '%/%'
